scientific_integrity: Distributional and fractional-moment assertions are derived analytically, and finite exact-kernel quadrature comparisons are only consistency checks. Publication priority against unindexed general stable-clock hitting theorems remains uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Annealed first passage for symmetric half-line walks with independent rates resampled at deterministic fixed intervals, under the specified Laplace regular-variation condition; no quenched law, convergence rate, or variable-interval assertion. General stable subordination and the source spectral representation are prior work.
title: Universal distance-scaled first-passage law for fluctuating jump rates
